fr_html: Le PRESIDENT exprime l'avis que le moment est venu pour le Comité de nommer un rapporteur. Il propose le nom de M. de Lapradelle.
en_html: The PRESIDENT said that he thought that the time had come when it would be useful for the Committee to appoint a rapporteur. He suggested the name of M. de Lapradelle.
